title: Qwen 2.5 VL Text Extractor
description: Layout-preserving document extraction powered by Qwen 2.5 VL or any OpenAI-compatible vision-language model. Supports PDF, PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP inputs. Requires an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint URL (e.g. vLLM, Ollama, TGI).

adapter_name.title: Name
adapter_name.description: Provide a unique name for this adapter instance. Example: qwen-vl-1

base_url.title: OpenAI-Compatible API URL
base_url.description: URL of your self-hosted OpenAI-compatible API endpoint. For vLLM: http://host:8000/v1, Ollama: http://host:11434/v1, TGI: http://host:8080/v1. Can also be set via the QWEN_BASE_URL environment variable.

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: API key for the endpoint. Most self-hosted servers (vLLM, Ollama) do not require an API key — leave as 'not-needed'. Can also be set via the QWEN_API_KEY environment variable.

model_name.title: Model Name
model_name.description: Model identifier as registered on your serving endpoint. Examples: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct, Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, qwen2.5-vl:72b (Ollama).

custom_prompt.title: Custom System Prompt / Instructions
custom_prompt.description: Optional additional instructions appended to the built-in layout-preserving extraction prompt. Use this to customise output formatting, focus on specific sections, or handle domain-specific content.
